# FG-DEPLOY-0011

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_commit_off_the_protected_branches_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このコミットはデプロイできません。保護されたブランチにあるコミットだけをデプロイできます（本番は CI が成功したものだけ）。
- en: This commit cannot be deployed. Only a commit on a protected branch can be deployed (for production, one whose CI pipeline succeeded).
- id: Commit ini tidak dapat di-deploy. Hanya commit pada branch yang dilindungi yang dapat di-deploy (untuk produksi, yang pipeline CI-nya berhasil).

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11 review (ADR-0031 amendment 2026-11-13): a requested SHA must be a commit of the project reachable from a branch some protection rule protects (an applied merge request merge or a commit pushed to a protected branch: both passed the protection), checked with git (`merge-base` against each protected branch tip, argv, the browse timeout); prod also needs a succeeded push pipeline of that SHA. `reason`: `commit_not_found`, `not_on_protected_branch`, `no_succeeded_pipeline`. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route logs the refusal with `error_code`, `request_id`, `project_id`, `environment`, `reason`. Check by hand: git --git-dir <repository> merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> refs/heads/<protected branch>; SELECT id, status FROM forge.ci_pipelines WHERE project_id = <id> AND sha = <sha>;

## 対処 (fix)

Merge the change through a merge request into a protected branch (or protect the branch), wait for its pipeline to succeed, and request that SHA.
